headline: Maui MPO TAC

meeting.summary: The committee approved September 1 minutes, heard a resident's testimony, and reviewed draft changes to how transportation projects are ranked.
meeting.recap: The Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee meeting began at 9:00 a.m. on October 6, 2026.[[0:00:30]] Members voted aye to approve the minutes of the September 1, 2026 meeting.[[0:07:11]] A resident urged the committee to bring back plans for a relief route, or bypass road, discussed for 25 years.[[0:09:43]] The resident opposed a proposal to put up gates and close a road on the north shore.[[0:10:58]] The resident asked for more Maui Bus routes, including a shuttle a few times a day to and from Hāna.[[0:11:29]] The executive director said the kickoff for a travel demand model update contract is tomorrow.[[0:13:29]] Safe routes to school software is due by the end of October.[[0:13:38]] Staff proposed giving committee members a full month to review Transportation Improvement Program items before they go to the policy board.[[0:17:46]] Staff shared draft goals for ranking projects, including tracking roads where serious injuries and deaths happen.[[0:22:29]] Staff will send the draft to members for feedback.[[0:28:57]] Staff said they have raw crash data but need to remove sensitive details before posting maps publicly.[[0:32:35]] Several members described what their departments do.[[0:34:54]] The next meeting is November 4 at 9:00 a.m., the last one this calendar year.[[0:46:54]]
decided: Members voted aye on a motion to approve the September 1, 2026 meeting minutes.
meeting.next: Staff will send the draft project ranking changes to committee members for feedback. The executive director will send a follow-up email about a training for board members. Staff will co-organize a walk audit with the Department of Health later this year or early next year. Staff offered to show crash maps to individual members, with notes on how the data was collected.

moments.q: Staff explain proposed Transportation Improvement Program policy changes
Chair asks whether a crash map is being produced
